canonical_statement: For a sufficiently regular time-independent Lagrangian on a finite-dimensional real normed vector space, an infinitesimal vertical variational symmetry up to the total time derivative of a configuration-dependent boundary term gives a Noether charge with derivative zero along every Euler-Lagrange trajectory.
domain_and_universes: universe u; E : Type u; NormedAddCommGroup E; NormedSpace Real E; FiniteDimensional Real E; time domain Real; scalar-valued Lagrangian and charge
hypotheses: IsRegularFor E D q: differentiability of the Lagrangian, generator, and boundary, and ContDiff Real 2 q
IsVariationalSymmetry E D: the infinitesimal Lagrangian variation equals the directional derivative of the boundary term
IsEulerLagrange E D q: the momentum covector has derivative equal to the position derivative along q
conclusion: For every t : Real, HasDerivAt (noetherCharge E D q) 0 t.

scope_decisions.theorem_variant: Noether's first theorem, forward implication only
scope_decisions.symmetry: vertical infinitesimal configuration transformation; time is fixed
scope_decisions.conservation_form: HasDerivAt charge 0 at every real time

degenerate_cases: Zero generators and zero boundary terms remain in scope. Singular Lagrangians are not excluded. The whole real time line is used, so endpoint and local-flow questions are outside this selected vector-space statement.

killed: restricted quasi-invariance to strict symmetry by requiring boundary = 0
replaced HasDerivAt by an equality using deriv's fallback value

status_boundary: This freezes and elaborates one exact finite-dimensional Noether target. It neither proves that target nor accepts its historical-source fidelity, anchor audit, obligation tree, proof, validation, or release nodes.
